1.name: Warehouse Location Count
1.sql: SELECT warehouse_location, COUNT(warehouse_location) AS warehouse_location_count FROM inventory GROUP BY warehouse_location

3.name: Top 3 Expenses
3.sql: SELECT account, SUM(amount) as total_amount FROM accounting GROUP BY account ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 3

4.name: Current Stock by Category
4.sql: SELECT category, SUM(current_stock) as total_amount FROM inventory GROUP BY category

5.name: Customers by Industry
5.sql: SELECT industry, COUNT(industry) AS industry_count FROM customer GROUP BY industry

6.name: Invoice Payment Method
6.sql: SELECT payment_method, COUNT(payment_method) AS total_method FROM invoice GROUP BY payment_method

8.name: Customer Count by Region
8.sql: SELECT region, COUNT(customer_id) AS count FROM customer GROUP BY region
